considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a paved driveway that loops in front of the residence and allows for turnaround. Mature pine trees surround much of the property and may limit visibility and sightlines in some areas. Open dry ground around the house provides reasonable space for emergency vehicle staging. The property is located in a semi-rural residential area with spaced homes and road access.
